description: Ranked changes for the bio page from its numbers: fix a broken link, move a link that beats its spot above one that trails, feature the best link, hide one nobody taps, rename one whose name says little. Each comes with evidence in words, chance_better and the exact call that makes it (apply). Broken links come first, then the surest. Pinned links are never moved. With source, the moves are for that app's own order (bio_variant_set).

check_links.description: Open up to 30 of the page's links to find broken ones (a few seconds)

source.description: Suggest for visitors from one app; moves then set that app's own order

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_suggest
title: Ideas for the link page
